title: InsightVision: A Comprehensive, Multi-Level Chinese-based Benchmark for Evaluating Implicit Visual Semantics in Large Vision Language Models
findings: The paper does not provide specific findings related to religion. General findings indicate a considerable gap between current LVLMs and human performance, particularly in understanding implicit meanings. Performance was lower in categories involving deep cultural symbols or metaphors, which could include religious contexts, but no specific data for the religious subcategory was presented.
